thread:
Marta: Heads-up from a partner onboarding: README CLI examples and the Rust sample are causing copy/paste friction. Two separate issues: CLI flag changed, and Rust snippet blocks on new runtime.
Marta: CLI example in README currently: `redwood run --api-key $REDWOOD_API_KEY --model redwood-1` which errors with `unknown flag: --api-key` for the latest CLI (we switched to --token).
Izan: Oh right, CLI flag renamed in v0.9.0. Where's that README?
Marta: docs/cli/quickstart.md lines ~10-28. Also the C# example uses `Authorization: ApiKey $TOKEN` which our servers don't accept.
Ruth: Can you paste the Rust snippet? I want to see the blocking issue.
Marta: Rust snippet (current):
```rust
let client = redwood::Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_API_KEY").unwrap());
let resp = client.chat().create(vec![Message::user("hi")]);
println!("{:?}", resp);
```
Marta: That blocks because the Rust SDK is async and requires Tokio runtime / await. New snippet should show an async main with tokio::main and `.await` on create. New users copy the blocking example, paste into main.rs, and get runtime panics.
Izan: Ugh. Small fixes: (1) change CLI docs to use `--token` and show env var export, (2) update C# `Authorization: Bearer` header sample, (3) replace Rust snippet with async example and add small note about using `tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros"] }`.
docs-bot: Snippet-linter results: found deprecated CLI flag `--api-key` in docs/cli/quickstart.md, header pattern `Authorization: ApiKey` in docs/samples/csharp.md, and blocking Rust snippet in docs/samples/rust.md. Rule IDs: doc-cli-flag-2026, doc-csharp-auth-2026, doc-rust-async-2026.
Kai: I'll open a single PR that touches the three files and adds a test in samples/verify-snippets.sh to flag `--api-key` and `Authorization: ApiKey` patterns and to assert Rust examples include `tokio::main` or `async fn main`. Keeps parity and prevents regressions.
Marta: Nice. Can we also add a tiny note in the CLI changelog linking to the docs change so support can triage quickly? Support tickets came in this morning.
support-bot: Automagic: I created ticket SUP-4211 linking onboarding failure to docs mismatch and associated PR when available.
Izan: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/928 - updates CLI flag, fixes C# header, replaces Rust snippet with async example, and adds snippet-linter checks.
Ruth: Thanks! After merge, can someone ping the partner who reported it and close the support ticket? I can help verify the partner doesn't need code changes beyond copy/paste.
Marta: Will do. Also adding a quick note in CONTRIBUTING.md telling authors to run `samples/verify-snippets.sh` locally; newbies keep forgetting. :sweat_smile:
docs-bot: Preview deployed for PR #928: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-928 - snippet-linter green. :white_check_mark:
Kai: Merged. Closing this thread. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone. :rocket:
